title: Spider-Kill it
author: thecyborg2218
description:
There is a spider in your room, it should not exist.
Armed with bad ideas and worse reflexes, you must confront the eight-legged menace in your personal space. Will you run? Fight? Light your entire room on fire? Every choice is a mistake—some just hurt less than others.

A short, chaotic Twine game with multiple endings, questionable logic, and one (1) spider too many.
